```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)  # for data manipulation and visualization
library(readxl)     # for reading Excel files
library(ggplot2)   # for data visualization#
library(emmeans)    # for estimated marginal means
library(htmlTable)  # for creating HTML tables
library(multcomp)   # for multiple comparisons
library(lmerTest)   # for linear mixed models with p-values
library(lme4)       # for linear mixed models



```
```{r loading data + reformatting}

#uploading data
data <- read_xlsx("./DATA/Field_data_maize.xlsx")

# Creating factors
#data$Genotype <- as.factor(data$Genotype)
#data$Block <- as.factor(data$Block)
#data$Plot <- as.factor(data$Plot)

# turning multiple columns into factors #ctrl+enter to execute line 40
data <- data %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(Genotype,Block,Plot),as.factor)

#structure of the data set
str(data)
#summary of the data set
summary(data)

# summary statistics for Plant height
summary(data$Plant_height)
```

# {.tabset}

## Fitting a linear model to plant height (at the plant level)

 
```{r fitting LM to plant height}

# fitting LM to Plant height
#block and genotype are fixed effects, plot is not included in the model because we are #analyzing plant level data
mod1 <- lm(Plant_height ~ Block + Genotype, data = data) 

#summary of mod1
summary(mod1)

# plotting residuals
plot(mod1)

#table of fixed effects
#testing the fixed effects of Block and Genotype on Plant height
anova1<-anova(mod1)
anova1


# making a nice table with ANOVA results
Table1<-as_tibble(anova1)%>% 
  rename ("SS" = "Sum Sq", "MS"="Mean Sq", "F" = "F value", "Pr" = "Pr(>F)")%>%
  add_column(fixed_effect =rownames(anova1))%>%
  mutate(SS = round(SS, digits = 3), MS = round(MS, digits = 3), F = round(F,digits = 3),Pr = round(Pr, digits = 3))

htmlTable(Table1, caption = "Table1: ANOVA table for Plant Height (plant level)",rnames = FALSE)

# extracting adjusted means for Genotype and tibble them

emmeans1<-emmeans(mod1,specs = "Genotype")
#emmeans1
Table2 <- emmeans1%>%
  as_tibble()%>% mutate(emmean = round(emmean, digits = 3), SE = round(SE, digits = 3),lower.CL = round(lower.CL,digits = 3), upper.CL = round(upper.CL,digits = 3))

htmlTable(Table2, caption = "Table2: Adjusted genotype means for plant height (plant level)"
          ,rnames = FALSE
          )



# making pairwise comparisons and adding letters to each mean
#place cursor over cld() and press F1 to see the help file
comp1 <- cld(object = emmeans1,
                       adjust = "sidak",
                       Letters = letters,
                       alpha = 0.05, sort=FALSE, type = "response")

# turning the pairwise comparisons into a nice table
Table3 <-as_tibble(comp1) %>% mutate(emmean = round(emmean, digits = 3), SE = round(SE, digits = 3),LCL = round(lower.CL,digits = 3), UCL = round(upper.CL,digits = 3))%>% dplyr::select(Genotype,emmean,SE,.group)

# making Table3 html proof
htmlTable(Table3, caption = "Table3: Comparison between Genotype means for Plant Height (plant level) at the 5% significance level",
rnames = FALSE)



```

## Fitting linear mixed model to plant height (at the plot level)

 
```{r fitting LMM to plant height}

# fitting LMM to Plant height
# plot as random effect, block and genotype as fixed effects
# plants comimg from single plot are not independent, so we need to include plot as a random effect
#plant observations are grouped within plots
#df = nrow(data) - length(unique(data$Block)) - length(unique(data$Genotype)) - 1
#df for genotype =50-1-(10-1)-(5-1)=36
mod2 <- lmer(Plant_height ~ Block + Genotype + (1|Plot), data = data)

#summary of mod2
summary(mod2)

#table of fixed effects
anova2<-anova(mod2)
#anova2

# table of variance components
vcomp2 <- as_tibble(VarCorr(mod2))%>% rename("Source" = "grp", "Var" = "vcov")
#vcomp2


# making a nice table with ANOVA results
Table4<-as_tibble(anova2)%>% 
  rename ("SS" = "Sum Sq", "MS"="Mean Sq", "F" = "F value", "Pr" = "Pr(>F)")%>%add_column(fixed_effect =rownames(anova2))%>%
  mutate(SS = round(SS, digits = 3), MS = round(MS, digits = 3), F = round(F,digits = 3),DenDF = round(DenDF, digits = 0),Pr = round(Pr, digits = 3))

# making Table4 html proof
htmlTable(Table4, caption = "Table4: ANOVA table for Plant Height (plot level)",
rnames = FALSE)

# extracting adjusted means for Genotype and tibble them

emmeans2<-emmeans(mod2,specs = "Genotype")  # emmeans as data frame
Table5 <- emmeans2%>%
  as_tibble()%>% mutate(emmean = round(emmean, digits = 3), SE = round(SE, digits = 3),df = round(df,digits = 0), lower.CL = round(lower.CL,digits = 3), upper.CL = round(upper.CL,digits = 3))

#making Table5 html proof
htmlTable(Table5, caption = "Table5: Adjusted genotype means for plant height (plot level)",
rnames = FALSE)


# making pairwise comparisons and adding letters to each mean
comp2 <- cld(object = emmeans2,
                       adjust = "sidak",
                       Letters = letters,
                       alpha = 0.05, sort=FALSE, type = "response")

# turning the pairwise comparisons into a nice table
Table6 <-as_tibble(comp2) %>% mutate(emmean = round(emmean, digits = 3), SE = round(SE, digits = 3),lower.CL = round(lower.CL,digits = 3), upper.CL = round(upper.CL,digits = 3))%>% dplyr::select(Genotype,emmean,SE,.group)

# making Table6 html proof
htmlTable(Table6, caption = "Table6: Comparison between Genotype means for Plant Height (plot level) at the 5% significance level",
rnames = FALSE)

# bar chart with error bars and letters for significant differences

# version1
ggplot(Table6, aes(x = Genotype, y = emmean,fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = .group), vjust = -1) +
  labs(title = "Adjusted Genotype Means for Plant Height (Plot Level)",
       x = "Genotype",
       y = "Adjusted Mean Plant Height") +
  theme_minimal()

# version2: with rotated x-axis labels
ggplot(Table6, aes(x = Genotype, y = emmean,fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = .group), vjust = -1) +
  labs(title = "Adjusted Genotype Means for Plant Height (Plot Level)",
       x = "Genotype",
       y = "Adjusted Mean Plant Height") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

# version3: with rotated x-axis labels and no legend
ggplot(Table6, aes(x = Genotype, y = emmean,fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = .group), vjust = -1) +
  labs(title = "Adjusted Genotype Means for Plant Height (Plot Level)",
       x = "Genotype",
       y = "Adjusted Mean Plant Height") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")






```

## HERITABILITY ESTIMATION

```{r HERITABILITY ESTIMATION}
#install.packages("heritable")
library(heritable)

## fitting lmm with genotype as random to Plant height
mod3 <- lmer(Plant_height ~ Block + (1|Genotype) + (1|Plot), data = data)

# table of variance components
vcomp3 <- as_tibble(VarCorr(mod3))%>% rename("Source" = "grp", "Var" = "vcov")
vcomp3



H2_Cullis(mod3, target = "Genotype")

H2_Piepho(mod3, target = "Genotype")

H2_Standard(mod3, target = "Genotype")  # broad sense heritability

```
